reply: Best candidate: rate = −[(6.32·A + 1.20·A²)/(1 + 0.296·A) + (0.0101 − 3.72·A)·e^(0.0000206·t) + (0.00595 − 0.00252·A)·t³ − 1.26e-5·t²·A], with dA/dt = −rate. The structure is roughly a saturating A-dependence plus a time-dependent term that rises steeply with t at low A and falls with t at high A.
